title: Humanvoice evidence item
description: A source or software observation tied to a claim, a fixture, or a product choice, with provenance and appraisal state. Per architecture §2: an evidence item may motivate a finding rule or a reader question, but it cannot silently alter a document. Per release_authority, missing critical evidence for a load-bearing claim is a never-except condition.

source_path_or_url.description: Where the observation came from: a snapshot-relative evidence file, a published source, or a software artifact

source_hash.description: Digest of the evidence source, so a claim can be re-checked against the exact bytes that supported it

observation.description: What the evidence states, quoted or closely paraphrased. Figures appear here in the form the source uses.

kind.description: How the observation was obtained. author-assertion carries no external support and cannot alone support a load-bearing claim.

obtained_by.description: Person or process that captured the observation

measuring_party.description: Who performed a measurement, when that differs from who recorded it. Null when the source does not state it; an unstated measuring party is a known gap, not an inference.

measurement_window.description: Period the observation covers, when applicable. Null when the source does not bound it.

citation_key.description: BibTeX key when the evidence is a published source

appraisal_state.description: Reviewer judgment of evidential weight. insufficient records that the item cannot support the claim it was gathered for; the claim must then be qualified, re-sourced, or withdrawn.

target_kind.description: What this evidence is tied to

load_bearing.description: Whether the target fails without this evidence. A load-bearing tie with appraisal_state of insufficient or unappraised blocks release.

supports.description: Claims, fixtures, or choices this observation is tied to. An empty array records evidence gathered but not yet connected to anything.

limitations.description: What the evidence does not establish, stated by the reviewer rather than inferred

contradicts.description: record_ids of evidence items this one conflicts with. A contradiction is preserved, not resolved by deletion.

privacy_class.description: Handling class; governs whether the observation may appear in a reader packet

rights_record_id.description: record_id of the CorpusItem carrying rights clearance, when the evidence is third-party material
